messages:
aisha: Heads-up — AcmeCorp flagged a month-end mismatch. Dashboard shows ~120k tokens for Nov-30 but the invoice/ledger only lists ~80k. Customer is escalating, they need root cause and a repro.
ben: On it. Can you paste the account id and which dashboard report they compared?
aisha: acct_acme_987, they compared /billing/dashboard/monthly-summary (UI export) vs the final invoice PDF. They say the dashboard line for 'pro' plan tokens is inflated.
carlos: Did they recently change plans or have any usage spikes from 23:30-00:30 UTC? Partition merges often bite us around cutoff.
aisha: Customer says no plan change. They saw a burst around 23:50 UTC but think it was retries from their side. Invoice-bot: Invoice 2023-11-30 for acct_acme_987: total_tokens=80312, plan=pro-monthly, invoice_ts=1701427200.
dana: I want to check ingestion window vs billing window. Ben — can you run the per-day token attribution query grouped by ingestion_partition and route? Use this quick snippet:
```
SELECT ingestion_partition, route, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id='acct_acme_987' AND day='2023-11-30'
GROUP BY ingestion_partition, route
ORDER BY ingestion_partition;
```
ben: Running now. Expecting ~120k if dashboard is right. If there's a late parquet/backfill it will show up on a later partition.
ben: Quick results: partitions: p20231130_1=80200 tokens, p20231130_2=39821 tokens, total=120021. p20231130_2 last_write_ts=1701513530 (2023-11-30 23:58:50 UTC).
carlos: Aha — partition 2 wrote at 23:58:50. Our billing cutoff job ran at 23:59:00 and the invoice generator used the ledger snapshot from 23:55:00 due to a lag in the snapshotting service. So UI (which reads eventstore + recent partitions) shows 120k but the final invoice used an earlier snapshot.
aisha: So the invoice omitted around 39.8k tokens that landed in a late partition right before cutoff. Customer will be angry. What are options?
dana: We have two levers: 1) Recompute the invoice from the latest ledger snapshot and issue a corrected invoice (finance + compliance ok?), 2) If correction not allowed, issue a one-time credit for the delta and document the cause. Need finance signoff.
ben: For the recompute path I can re-run the ledger rollup including p20231130_2 and produce a reconciliation diff. I'll attach the SQL diff in a sec.
ben: Repro steps for internal triage: 1) query last_write_ts for partitions for target day; 2) check snapshot job logs at 23:50-00:05 UTC (deploys: snapshotter v2.1.4); 3) confirm invoice generator's snapshot_id; 4) produce delta CSV and compute tax/discount apportionment.
carlos: Root cause looks like a transient GC pause on the snapshotter causing it to miss the latest partition when it wrote snapshot_id=sn_20231130_235500. The snapshot service had a 45s stall. I'm opening an incident on eng-infra to track fixes (dedupe/heartbeat).
aisha: Customer asked for timeline and fix. Ben — can you produce a short reconciliation table they can use in the meantime? Keep it to one CSV: partition, tokens, included_in_invoice (yes/no), delta.
ben: Done. CSV uploaded to shared drive. Summary: invoice_tokens=80312, dashboard_tokens=120021, delta=39689 (all attributed to partition p20231130_2 written at 23:58:50).
dana: For long-term: we'll add a snapshot-wait ack — have the snapshotter verify parity with ingestion partitions up to cutoff time (and delay invoice generation by 2m if mismatch). Filed RFC for redwood/infra#412.
carlos: Also adding an alert if snapshotter stall >10s during billing window.
invoice-bot: Customer notified via support ticket #SUP-22419.
aisha: Sending customer a transparent note: explain root cause (late partition + snapshot race), offer corrected invoice or a one-time credit, ETA for internal fix and alerting.
ben: Finance confirmed we can reissue corrected invoice for this account (compliance signed off) — I will schedule it for tomorrow morning.
aisha: Thanks team. I'll send the customer the reconciliation CSV and expected corrected invoice ETA. :white_check_mark:
ben: Follow-up action items: (1) eng-infra incident ticket, (2) finance reissue invoice, (3) product RFC to harden snapshotter, (4) support note template for 'late-ingest' monthend cases.
aisha: Noting for postmortem: severity=low-medium (billing exposure nonzero, small number of customers affected). Closing thread once invoice reissued.
